product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.summary: The P2U brought the P2 range to 64 KiB usable with its version of CP/M.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.history: Triumph-Adler offered the P2U as a further expansion of its office system. In May 1982 it was listed at DM 8,700 before VAT, including the monitor.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.technical.con: The software in use determines how much memory is available. The 64 KiB version of CP/M can use all the RAM. BASIC and 48 KiB CP/M have 48 KiB available.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.technical.lim: The model’s character generator, keyboard and complete boot process remain to be verified. MAME includes the P2U and marks it as not working.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2u.technical.fir: Wiertalla’s 6 KiB MOS set matches all three P2U SHA-1 values in MAME. A different P2U is the reported source of the CAAP-2500-2601 dump, which remains to be acquired.
